summary: Frontend-only review of Bug 4 fix for pending_approval and rejected status badge rendering in ESGRecordsTracker.js and ESGTrackingTab.js. Verified the code logic via source review and confirmed the tracker UI loads correctly at /workflow/tracker. Live visual verification of the dual-badge rendering ('Completed'+'Awaiting Approval' for pending_approval; 'Pending'+'Rejected' for rejected) was not possible because the current org (ORG1, FY2026-2027) has no assignments with status pending_approval or rejected (API /api/esg-records/tracker/environment returned 20 assignments: 17 pending, 1 in_progress, 2 cancelled; approval_status=none for all).

code_review_findings.ESGRecordsTracker.js getStatusBadge (lin: CORRECT. For status='pending_approval': labels[status]='Completed', effectiveStatusColor=STATUS_COLORS.completed (green), effectiveApprovalStatus='pending_approval' -> renders 'Completed' (green) + 'Awaiting Approval' (amber). For status='rejected': labels[status]='Pending', effectiveStatusColor=STATUS_COLORS.pending (stone/gray), effectiveApprovalStatus='rejected' -> renders 'Pending' (gray) + 'Rejected' (red). Colors defined at lines 94-108.
code_review_findings.ESGTrackingTab.js StatusBadge (lines 105: CORRECT. hasDataSubmitted array now includes 'rejected' (line 107), so isOverdue/isDueSoon early returns are skipped when status=='rejected'. statusMap.pending_approval -> {label:'Completed'}, statusMap.rejected -> {label:'Pending'}. effectiveApprovalStatus resolves to 'pending_approval' or 'rejected' accordingly and renders the second amber/red badge. Effective status color for rejected uses STATUS_COLORS.not_started (gray) - acceptable as 'pending-like'.
code_review_findings.Consistency: Both components are aligned - dual-badge pattern is consistent.

action_items: Main agent should visually verify by creating a task submission that lands in pending_approval, and an approver rejection to create a rejected task. Then re-check the ESGRecordsTracker (/workflow/tracker) subcategory/task rows and the ESGTrackingTab (per-category detail) show the expected dual badges.
Optional: Seed a demo assignment with status=pending_approval and one with status=rejected for the admin org to make regression testing of this UI easier in future iterations.
